title: Quasi-identifier linking through sensor telemetry combination
description: The combination of heart rate, step counts, GPS position, and timestamps can serve as quasi-identifiers that may link data to a specific individual, especially when combined with other data sources.
assumptions: Assumes the data is accessible to third parties or can be correlated with other datasets.

title: Profiling through continuous sensor data analysis

title: Quasi-identifiable information in sensor data

assumptions: Assumes the data is not properly anonymized or pseudonymized.

title: Revealing location attributes
description: GPS position data is a revealing attribute that can support identification of the data subject's location and movement patterns.
assumptions: Assumes GPS data is transmitted and stored.

title: Small anonymity set through precise location tracking
description: Continuous GPS tracking with timestamps can create a small anonymity set, allowing an individual to be singled out from a group based on their unique movement patterns.
assumptions: Assumes the tracking is continuous and precise enough to distinguish the individual from others.

title: Sensitive health data collection
